# Benchmarks

<!-- Generated by scripts/bench_engine.py from docs/benchmarks/*.json. Do not edit. -->

Every engine and model voiced ships, measured the same way on named Macs, so
you can choose one by its numbers. The protocol, the clip set and why the
ratings are what they are: [ADR 0024](decisions/0024-engine-benchmarks.md).
Each row names its machine, the voiced version and commit measured and the
date; numbers from different machines do not compare.

To add or refresh a row, start nothing and run, from a checkout with
`uv sync --group dev --all-extras`, on a Mac with nothing else running:

```sh
uv run python scripts/bench_engine.py stt --engine <name> [--model <repo>]
uv run python scripts/bench_engine.py tts --engine <name> [--model <repo>]
```

It writes the result to `docs/benchmarks/` and regenerates this file;
`uv run python scripts/bench_engine.py render` only regenerates it.

## Speech to text

WER: word error rate over 24 clips of LibriSpeech test-clean (Panayotov et al. 2015, CC BY 4.0, openslr.org/12), after normalizing case and punctuation. Finalize: from the client's `end` to the final transcript, streaming in real time in 64 and 100 ms chunks. RTF: processing time over audio time.

| Model | Engine | Quality | Speed | WER | Finalize after 200 ms silence, median / worst | Finalize at the last word, median / worst | Batch RTF | Load | Footprint | MLX peak, load / after use | Size | Languages | Licence | Machine | Version (commit), date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `mlx-community/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3` | parakeet | 5 of 5 | 5 of 5 | 2.0% | 1 / 6 ms | 115 / 129 ms | 0.023 | 1.0 s | 1.52 GB | 3.38 GB / 3.38 GB | 2.5 GB | 25 languages | CC-BY-4.0 | MacBook Pro, Apple M1 Max, 64 GB, macOS 15.7.4 | 0.1.1 (a9b3c96+), 2026-10-21 |

## Text to speech

## Ratings

Quality and speed, 1 to 5, come from the numbers above by these limits (`voiced.ratings`). Speed is the lower of its two ratings (the latency and the throughput a user waits on). The app's model list will show them (ADR 0024 section 5).

| Rating | Measure | 5 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| STT quality | word error rate on the clip set | <= 3% | <= 5% | <= 8% | <= 12% | otherwise |
| STT speed | finalize after 200 ms of silence, worst | <= 50 ms | <= 150 ms | <= 300 ms | <= 600 ms | otherwise |
| STT speed | batch real-time factor | <= 0.05 | <= 0.1 | <= 0.2 | <= 0.5 | otherwise |
| TTS quality | UTMOS naturalness | >= 4.3 | >= 4 | >= 3.6 | >= 3 | otherwise |
| TTS speed | first audio, median | <= 100 ms | <= 200 ms | <= 400 ms | <= 800 ms | otherwise |
| TTS speed | real-time factor | <= 0.1 | <= 0.25 | <= 0.5 | <= 1 | otherwise |
